The serious, lovable, and curious Qing Jing Peak master Shen Qingqiu, Shizun to the sweet, charismatic, and extremely jealous disciple Luo Binghe. Both come from the first original work by Mo Xiang Tong Xiu, The Scum Villain’s Self-Saving System ([i]Ren Zha Fanpai Zijiu Xitong[/i]).[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1273160384680955955/1500169426136465438/EspadaXinMo.png?ex=69f77526&is=69f623a6&hm=aa859ae5d60e6843a58f94a5757cf95cfc41ab7b28b2b154168179ae4f34ae98&[/img]

[left]It would be helpful if the player had some prior knowledge of the original story, but I’m doing my best to make the mod’s story and characters feel almost completely independent, so players won’t need to read the source material before playing.[/left]
[left]
The characters themselves will gradually reveal parts of their past and talk about the present, and the more the player works to build a bond with them, by increasing friendship, the closer they’ll get to uncovering the future of the story.

I don’t plan on spoiling what I have planned for the mod’s storyline, but what the player will be able to know right from the start is:[/left]
[left]
[list]
[*]Shen Qingqiu and Luo Binghe arrived shortly before the player, but they have already settled in the village, even if doing so little by little.[/*]
[*]Characters grow as the player develops with them. The greater their friendship, the more development there is in their individual and duo stories, both between them and the player alone, and with other villagers.[/*]
[*]Shen Qingqiu is the first starting point that will tell the player why they are both in Pelican Village, their reasons and causes and it is automatically up to the player to help the couple develop their storyline, just playing normally and creating new friendships.[/*]
[*]Luo Binghe will be the key point in the future that will conclude the first arc of the mod's history, but that's something to talk about only later.[/*]
[/list][line]

[/center]

[left]The characters are a couple officially, both for the player and for all the villagers, at no point is this a secret, [i][s]but it's not an impediment to anything either. [/s][/i][/left]
[left]
Both have been through a lot in the past, they have their own history, but when they arrive at Vila Pelicanos, it's as if their lives are given a new beginning, and this will affect both their current relationships and possible future ones.

[list]
[*]There will be future conflicts in the couple's relationship, where the player can directly interfere and their actions and decisions will have consequences.[/*]
[*]As mentioned before, the player will automatically help the characters' dual plot, but if it is an individual plot, it will depend on the player's future choices, where they can choose to help or not.[/*]
[/list][/left]

[quote][color=#ff0000][size=4][b][font=Arial Black][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1273160384680955955/1500182413849001984/xinmo2.png?ex=69f7813f&is=69f62fbf&hm=0c04c5fe26aa17255c964116f197d76da918e84ef505adffb6ef3eba46ca3e82&[/img]LUO BINGHE:[/font][/b][/size][size=4][font=Arial Black][b] [img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1273160384680955955/1500182413849001984/xinmo2.png?ex=69f7813f&is=69f62fbf&hm=0c04c5fe26aa17255c964116f197d76da918e84ef505adffb6ef3eba46ca3e82&[/img][/b][/font][/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][font=Arial]Binghe is a character deeply wounded by life, which, overall, was not kind to him in the slightest.

But in recent years, his greatest source of happiness has been his Shizun, Shen Qingqiu, who was the first and only person to show him what affection, kindness, and care are, and who taught him what it means to be truly important in someone’s life. Through him, Binghe learned for the first time what it means to love and to be loved.

Because of this, he ended up becoming insecure, and with that insecurity came jealousy as well. It is beyond his control to feel hurt whenever someone approaches Shen Qingqiu, catches his attention, or draws him away from him, even if only for a few seconds. This always triggers his abandonment issues.

For this reason, his first contact with the player will always be tense, with Binghe clearly showing that he dislikes the way the player “always interrupts his moments with Shizun.” But all of this is only a mask, because behind that strongly raised wall, there is someone emotionally wasted who, deep down, would love to have a new friend.

You'll be able to help this dear puppy overcome his insecurities, encourage him to create new bonds in the village, and who knows, maybe even... [i][s]open your heart to new possibilities?[/s][/i][/font][/color][/quote][center][/center]

[quote][size=4][color=#93c47d][b][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1273160384680955955/1500182414113112124/xiuya2.png?ex=69f7813f&is=69f62fbf&hm=78e82f875effc7ecc397abdbb1bd046df3a9cd2e855c4b080eca027c1d32482a&[/img] [font=Arial Black]SHEN QINGQIU:[/font][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1273160384680955955/1500182414113112124/xiuya2.png?ex=69f7813f&is=69f62fbf&hm=78e82f875effc7ecc397abdbb1bd046df3a9cd2e855c4b080eca027c1d32482a&[/img]
[/b][/color][/size]
[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=Arial]Shen Qingqiu is a character who possesses his many secrets, from the most unimaginable to those that would leave anyone speechless for at least 2 weeks.

He is basically the reason why his partner and he "suddenly moved" to Vila Pelicanos, and even though he can't tell the reason and why they were initially there, nothing stops him from throwing little indirect messages into the air, making jokes about it and not wanting to make some gaffes about the reason behind it, but of course, this until the player proves to be someone trustworthy enough to be able to know and keep this secret with them.

Shen is an elegant person, extremely kind and warm, has a temperament that is envious but whenever his limits are exceeded, he cannot resist showing remnants of a possible previous personality. He is a curious person by nature and whenever he leaves aside his cold and academic air, he demonstrates a version of himself that is extremely humorous and even quite sarcastic. 

Traveling to Pelicanos Village allowed and provided him to experience a calm life again, without his previous responsibilities, which practically handed him on a silver platter what could easily be considered a honeymoon, something he and his partner Binghe much more than enjoy.

But besides gaining time to enjoy alongside his partner, Shen also has an internal mission where he even comments on the matter with the player, in case their relationship progresses to two hearts. Together, the player and Shen can delve deeper into each other's story, but most importantly, complete this mission side by side.

In the midst of this adventure of discovery, Qingqiu also ends up delving into the stories of the villagers, creating a bond and friendship that makes him miss home, but which still makes him very happy to allow himself to experience it. And amidst so many new experiences... it would also be possible to delve deeper into... [i]new feelings?[/i] [s][i]What is this? Has it become romantic comedy history now? What nonsense would that be??[/i][/s]

But are you ready to venture out?[/font][/size][/color][/quote][line]

[left]I don't currently have much ready for what I plan. I'm extremely new to this world of mod creation and yes, this is my first mod made, but know that it's being built with great care!

It can be frustrating to end up releasing an incomplete mod, with few changes and compatibilities, but I decided to do this as a test, to discover bugs and resolve them before starting to implement new things, I would like to understand what the reception of the mod would be like and mainly, I want it to be my direct starting point, because if I didn't post it soon, I'm afraid I could end up losing gas because I have a half-bulging head, my Alzheimer's doesn't help me much either.

But currently what we have is the basics for the mod to work, but I will still cite it in a more organized way.

[b]We currently have in this version 0.5 of the mod:[/b][/left]
[left]
[list]
[*]Luo Binghe and Shen Qingqiu's 2-Heart Event;[/*]
[*]Dialogues for 0 and 2 hearts;[/*]
[*]4 basic and different routines for each spring week;[/*]
[*]4 individual routines, 2 from Shen and 2 from Luo on specific days;[/*]
[*]3 new food recipes that are part of the SVSSS universe and plot;[/*]
[*]1 crafting recipe;[/*]
[*]6 additional plot items with specific answers for each of them.[/*]
[*]3 mail-form quests for Shen and Luo, boosting friendship.[/*]
[/list]As I said before, it's not much and it doesn't delve into the characters yet, but it's the beginning so I can use it as a test and then start working on the next additions, where I plan to work concisely. 

And after verifying that the mod is working normally and fixing any bugs, I'll start working on the following additions: [/left]
[spoiler][left][/left]
[list]
[*]Luo Binghe and Shen Qingqiu's 4 Hearts Event;[/*]
[*]New lines of summer-specific dialogues;[/*]
[*]Addition of new clothing and custom portraits;[/*]
[*]4 new routines specific to each summer week;[/*]
[*]4 new individual routines for Shen and Luo, on specific summer days;[/*]
[*]Addition of new missions;[/*]
[*]Participation in festivals;[/*]
[*]Detail of new dialogues for the spring weeks;[/*]
[*]New scenes and events to deepen characters, 1 from Shen, 1 from Luo and 1 from the couple with the player;[/*]
[*]Dialogues for the villagers regarding the characters, as the player grows their hearts of friendship;[/*]

[/list]These will be the jobs for Mod update 0.6 that I will delve into. I plan to add and work on updates like this, with the goal of always completing the month, like the next update focusing on Fall and then Winter, so I can finally delve into larger projects.[/spoiler]

I'm really excited about this, and depending on how things go from here, I might be able to work harder and harder on even bigger things. You can see some of this if you'd like:

To install the mod is very simple. Currently it is necessary that you only have the Content Patcher installed and then put the mod directly in your Mods folder that you can already start playing. It's actually quite simple to do, but if you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask. ^^

After downloading the zip file, unzip it and [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Install_mods]move your contents to your Stardew Valley Mods folder[/url]﻿. Ensure that all necessary modifications [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] are installed and updated.

I did some quick tests with the SVE, Ridgeside Village and East Scarp mods and the mod works normally. Of course, it's not adapted to recognize festivals and other characters, but that will be added in the future. You can play with these 3 I mentioned without any huge issues, but if there are any incompatibilities, let me know and I will add that note for future additions.
